items.title: Appointment of finance officer
decisions: that Orla Doyle be appointed chief financial officer of the company from 1 November 2026

items.title: Office lease
items.notes: The secretary reported on the offer for the first floor at 4 Harbour Row.
decisions: that the company enter into a five-year lease of the first floor at €38,000 a year, and that Declan Walsh sign it for the company
